sources.title: unsloth/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model was further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it. ... The model underwent multi-environment reinforcement learning using GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) across instruction following, multi-step tool use, multi-turn conversations, and structured output environments. It utilized an asynchronous RL architecture that decouples training from inference. Software used for reinforcement learning: NeMo RL, NeMo Gym · NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB is a result of the above work.
